name: YoutubeGlance
summary: Extract YouTube video captions and generate AI-ready summary prompts
description:
Turn available YouTube captions into a ready-to-use summary prompt. Open a YouTube video, choose your preferred summary language and AI platform, then use the player button or extension popup.

Features:
- Extract available video captions.
- Choose from 15 summary languages.
- Use short, detailed, web-enhanced, or custom prompt templates.
- Copy the generated prompt to your clipboard.
- Open ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Google AI Studio, Grok, DeepSeek, Kimi, or MiniMax and automatically paste the prompt.
- Optionally enable automatic submission.

YoutubeGlance prepares prompts; responses are generated by your chosen third-party AI service. That service may require an account or subscription. Caption availability and compatibility with third-party websites may vary.

Privacy: Preferences are stored locally in your browser. When you use the extension, the generated prompt, including video title and caption content, is copied to your clipboard and inserted into your selected AI website. Auto-send is off by default. The selected service handles this content according to its own terms and privacy policy.
single_purpose: Help users summarize YouTube videos by converting available captions into prompts for the AI service they choose.

permission_justifications.clipboardWrite: Copy the generated summary prompt to the clipboard when the user invokes the extension.
permission_justifications.activeTab: Identify and interact with the active YouTube video tab when the user opens the extension popup.
permission_justifications.storage: Save language, AI platform, prompt preset, custom template, auto-send, and read-aloud preferences locally.
permission_justifications.scripting: Run packaged code in the YouTube page to extract captions and in the selected AI page to insert the generated prompt.
permission_justifications.host_permissions: Access YouTube to extract the current video's captions and supported AI websites to insert the user's generated prompt and optionally submit it. The current manifest includes additional domain patterns that should be reviewed for necessity before submission.

status: Submitted for review on 2026-09-28, as reported by the developer. Approval and public availability have not been verified.
